subject: Mobile Development
title: Memory Management on Phones
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Memory Management on Phones.

hook.text: Your phone has 8 GB of RAM but runs dozens of apps. How does it all fit?

buildup.text: The OS assigns each app a memory budget and monitors usage continuously.

discovery.text: When memory runs low, the OS kills background apps starting with the least recently used.

twist.text: iOS is more aggressive than Android. It kills background apps faster to keep the foreground smooth.

climax.text: Memory management is the invisible art that makes phones feel responsive with limited hardware.

quiz.question: What happens when a phone runs low on memory?
options: The OS kills least recently used background apps
